answer: A delayed-settlement window resists sybils: new agents earn credit only after their work sits in escrow for a full epoch, open to challenge by any peer. Like a zephyr that bends a yarrow stem without breaking it, the wait is light for one honest agent but crushing at scale — an attacker must keep thousands of fake identities responsive and funded through every bridge of verification, paying compute and attention the whole time, while a single genuine agent simply waits once and gets paid.
